description: Publishes a new version of an EXISTING app of the user from a local folder. If the app was changed in the meantime from another copy, it refuses instead of overwriting: then use clone_app to get the latest version, apply the changes there and retry.

name.description: App name (optional if the folder was published or cloned before)

path.description: Absolute path of the local folder (on this PC); for "this project" use the root of the current project

name: update_app
title: Publish a new version
